question: Which is the largest saline wetland in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Sambhar Lake**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sambhar Lake** is the largest saline wetland in **India**.
 
• It is located in the state of **Rajasthan**, near the towns of Sambhar, Jaipur, and Ajmer.
 
• The lake covers an area of around **190 to 230 square kilometers**, depending on the season.
